title: Hierarchical Proposition Decomposition for Automated Literature Synthesis: Systematic Investigation and Empirical Framework
summary: Complex scientific paragraphs contain multiple nested claims that confuse monolithic fact-checking models. We propose an AST-guided constituency parsing model that extracts fine-grained atomic propositions. On peer-reviewed manuscripts, our parser achieves 96.4% proposition extraction completeness with 0.91 inter-annotator agreement. Across systematic experimental evaluations, our approach achieves an acceleration factor of 1.6x and a verified task accuracy of 96.4% with mean execution latency of 0.45ms.
